description: Version history of an API, MCP server or agent, or the list of changes in one version. Use to see what was added, changed or removed over time.

slug.description: The entity's slug, as returned in search results (field `slug`), e.g. "mcp-hundily-com-63b5e97c".

version.description: Return the changes introduced in this version number. Omit to list all versions.

name: get_entity_versions
